# Mirza Muhammad Mobeen

> Software Engineer, AI Researcher, Project Manager, Team Lead, NUTECH & Fazaia FIC Nur Khan Alumnus, and Google Certified Digital Marketer based in Islamabad & Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

## About

Mirza Muhammad Mobeen (also known as Mirza M Mobeen, Mobeen, Mirza Mobeen) is a Software Engineer, AI Researcher, Project Manager, Team Lead, and Google Certified Digital Marketer. He is an alumnus of NUTECH (National University of Technology, Islamabad) and Fazaia Inter College Nur Khan (FIC Nur Khan / PAF, Rawalpindi). He is currently working as a Software Engineer at Sanwa Comtec K.K (SCT / SCTP), Japan, leading the Pakistan engineering team on Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Industrial Software Automation, Cybersecurity Solutions, and IBM i Systems.
